name: Project-Based Learning
description: Students learn by working over time on a meaningful project that results in a product, performance, or solution.

name: Problem-Based Learning
description: Students learn through investigating and responding to an authentic or complex problem.

name: Case-Based Learning
description: Students use cases to analyse situations, identify issues, and develop reasoned responses.

name: Inquiry-Based Learning
description: Students investigate questions, gather information, and construct understanding through inquiry.

name: Experiential Learning
description: Students learn through experience followed by reflection and application.

name: Flipped Classroom
description: Content exposure happens before class so classroom time can focus on application and interaction.

name: Peer Instruction
description: Students reason about a question, discuss their thinking with peers, and reconsider their answer.

name: Collaborative Learning
description: Students work together to construct understanding or complete a shared learning task.

name: Cooperative Learning
description: Students work in structured groups with defined roles and shared responsibility.

name: Design Thinking
description: Students empathise, define, ideate, prototype, and test solutions to meaningful problems.

name: Challenge-Based Learning
description: Students work on a meaningful challenge and develop an actionable response.

name: Simulation-Based Learning
description: Students learn by participating in a realistic simulation or model of a situation.

name: Role Play
description: Students take roles in a structured situation to explore perspectives, decisions, or processes.

name: Debate
description: Students develop and defend positions using reasoning and evidence.

name: Discussion-Based Learning
description: Structured discussion helps students develop, test, and communicate ideas.

name: Think-Pair-Share
description: Students first think independently, then discuss with a partner, and finally share with the class.

name: Gamification
description: Learning activities use selected game elements to increase engagement and participation.

name: Scenario-Based Learning
description: Students respond to realistic scenarios that require decisions or application.

name: Reflective Learning
description: Students examine an experience or learning process and make meaning from it.

name: Service Learning
description: Students connect learning with meaningful service or community-oriented activity.
